articles.title: Watch: BTS Takes 7th Win For “SWIM” On “Music Bank”; Performances By N.Flying, Kep1er, And More
articles.description: BTS has taken their seventh win for “SWIM”! On the April 3 episode of “Music Bank,” the candidates for first place were BTS’s “SWIM” and ITZY’s Yuna‘s “Ice Cream.” BTS ultimately took the prize with a total of 9,477 points. Congratulations to BTS! Watch the winner announcement below! articles.summary: BTS won their seventh music show trophy for "SWIM" on the April 3 episode of "Music Bank," defeating ITZY's Yuna's "Ice Cream" with 9,477 points. The episode also featured performances by various artists including N.Flying, Kep1er, ITZY's Yuna, and Red Velvet's Irene.
articles.author: MLim

articles.title: BTS To Release Surprise New Song “Come Over”
articles.description: Get ready for a brand-new song from BTS! On April 3, BIGHIT MUSIC announced that a surprise new track by BTS would be included on the Deluxe Vinyl edition of “ARIRANG,” which is set to be released today. articles.summary: BIGHIT MUSIC announced that BTS will release a surprise new song titled "Come Over" as part of the Deluxe Vinyl edition of their album "ARIRANG." The deluxe version will include the original 14 tracks plus the additional new track.
